name: Foam 70
notes: Sea foam as a coverage family: level N = N% wall material. All nine tips are thresholds of ONE growth-time field (tips/foam.spec.json): bubbles at four Worley scales with heavy-tailed per-cell radii, the field being how far every bubble must inflate before swallowing the point - so stepping the level down IS uniform bubble growth, walls thin everywhere at once, and the lace stays connected instead of retreating to junction dots (the absolute-distance field was tried and does exactly that). Round windows come from the f1 metric; Plateau-border thickening at junctions falls out of the geometry. Dual-gate train as oil-sponge; levels 10-20 use a sparser mask train so the thin lace prints through instead of double-exposing. Audited comb-free and isotropic; see docs/fractal-texture-math.md for the architecture. Wet froth: thick borders, scattered round windows.
